items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I met Ray Nance. He was my buddy.

ctx.x: I only shook hands with Duke. Yeah. No, I… I heard he said nice things about me to [Willa Deis?], who’s a Dutch personality. TV but no, not let’s not get into… That’s, that would be a little [drawing too hard?]. [laughs] Now, of course, that’s an [inaudible] like everybody said. [They said, or he said that?]. Nobody… He came once. I was playing with Peggy Lee in Las Vegas in the Flamingo something. And Duke, Duke’s band… we were playing in the big room, and Duke’s band was playing in the slot machine there, you…
